name: rust-discover-fixture-tests
body: A fixture repo must assert discovery: (a) a nested non-workspace crate and (b) a workspace, with both discovered and neither double-counted, plus the generated-tree exclusion case. Tests follow the scratch-repo discipline (no-real-project-test). AC: the fixture scan asserts each expected module node appears exactly once, no duplicate module node is present, and no generated target/ source appears.
